name: Shah Alam BOGO Offers
author: Md Shah Alam

sections.description:
Shah Alam BOGO Offers is a lightweight WooCommerce plugin that automatically adds free products to the cart when customers meet your Buy X Get Y promotion rules.

Whether you want to run a classic Buy 3 Get 1 Free campaign or create custom Buy X Get Y offers, Shah Alam BOGO Offers makes it simple.

Features

  • Automatically adds free products to the cart.
  • Configure Buy Quantity (X) and Free Quantity (Y).
  • Apply promotions to all simple products or selected products only.
  • Clean FREE badge displayed in Cart and Checkout.
  • Automatically updates free item quantities when the cart changes.
  • Automatically removes free items when requirements are no longer met.
  • Fully Compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage).
  • Lightweight and easy to use.
  • No WooCommerce core modifications.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the shah-alam-bogo-offers folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to BOGO Offers in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Configure your Buy X Get Y campaign.
  5. Save your settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support variable products?

No. Currently Shah Alam BOGO Offers supports WooCommerce Simple Products only.

Does it support HPOS?

Yes. Shah Alam BOGO Offers is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Does it automatically update free products?

Yes. Free items are automatically added, updated, and removed whenever the cart quantity changes.
